sample_unit: de-identified psychiatric notes (5,000-patient discovery cohort; 10,000-patient replication cohort)
unlisted_practices: LLM-derived structured factor extraction and weighting from unstructured EHR notes for severity prediction
Comparison of LLM-derived weights against randomized-weight, irrelevant-variable, and unweighted zero-shot controls

screen.reason: The study develops and tests an LLM pipeline for extracting clinical factors and predicting psychiatric severity retrospectively from EHR text, but does not evaluate a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
